en: Hand‑colored panoramic postcard showing a general view of Brașov with the red‑roofed old town in the foreground and the forested Tâmpa Mountain rising behind. Tree‑lined avenues and parks are visible, with scattered churches and civic buildings. The front bears the printed Romanian title "Brașov – Vedere generală." The reverse has Romanian postage stamps and a Brașov postmark, with an address written in Romanian.
